what: Bo's move for his own seat names, as its earlier version, Ada's move for her seat at an id Ada signed twice. A row naming an equivocated id as a parent is neither admitted nor reported, on either copy, whichever version of the parent it holds: it neither shows nor hides (review X1). A reader skipping the equivocated parent admits Bo's move; one reading the parent it holds reports SEAT_NOT_HELD.
